nodes.label: cms-access-control capability
nodes.rationale: D1: Posts/Pages access.read returns true for authenticated users and restricts anonymous requests to _status:published; Posts additionally declares create/update:isAdminOrWriter and delete:isAdmin after task-16.3 live verification found that Payload defaults any undefined access operation to () => true, which had briefly left Posts create/update/delete open to unauthenticated requests — the other 6 collections already defined their full access block. D2: Users keeps collection-level read open but hides email/role/active via field-level access so the public author shape (displayName/slug/avatar/bio/socialLinks) stays readable without exposing sensitive fields; rejected access.read:()=>false at the collection level. D3: a minimal beforeLogin hook blocks session tokens for active:false accounts, deliberately narrow so it doesn't touch other lifecycle behavior reserved for Phase 3.
